title: Validation scan of the Gran Sasso physics laboratory

In the case of the Gran Sasso, I used a different processing technique. It was like an experiment.
tellings.difference: Adds that the scan used an experimental processing technique and dates it to 2024.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Filippo's own scan of the Gran Sasso laboratory.

as_told.title: Gran Sasso laboratory scan with an experimental processing technique

plain: Before his scans of what lies under the Egyptian pyramids, Filippo Biondi, a scientist known for that work, says he tested his method by scanning the Gran Sasso physics laboratory in Italy, a site whose layout is already known. He tells Michels he did it in 2024 with a different processing technique and treated it as an experiment. The point of telling it is that if the scan matched the real laboratory, his readings under the pyramids would be harder to dismiss.
